jobs.title: SAP IS-U BPEM Exception Management Functional SME
jobs.description:
Job Summary
 



  
 



 We are seeking a Senior SAP IS\-U BPEM Exception Management Functional SME with strong hands\-on functional expertise in SAP IS\-U and Business Process Exception Management (BPEM). The ideal candidate will have extensive experience working in the utility industry, particularly around exception management, billing, meter\-to\-cash processes, and resolution of business process exceptions.
 



  
 



 The consultant will be responsible for analyzing business process exceptions, defining and configuring BPEM cases, identifying root causes, improving exception\-handling processes, and working closely with business and technical teams to ensure timely resolution of critical utility business issues.
 



  
 



 The role requires a strong understanding of SAP IS\-U business processes, BPEM framework, exception monitoring, case management, prioritization, and integration with key IS\-U processes such as Billing, Invoicing, Meter Reading, Device Management, Customer Service, Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA), and Move\-In/Move\-Out.
 



  
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 8\+ years of SAP IS\-U functional experience with strong utility industry knowledge.
 



 Strong hands\-on experience with SAP IS\-U BPEM (Business Process Exception Management).
 



 Proven experience as a BPEM Functional SME / Exception Management SME.
 



 Strong understanding of utility Meter\-to\-Cash (M2C) business processes.
 



 Experience analyzing, categorizing, prioritizing, and resolving SAP IS\-U business process exceptions.
 



 Strong knowledge of SAP IS\-U functional modules/processes, including:
 



 Billing
 



 Invoicing
 



 Meter Reading
 



 Device Management
 



 Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
 



 Move\-In / Move\-Out
 



 Customer Service
 



 Payments and Collections
 



 Experience configuring BPEM exception types, case categories, priorities, processors, and related processing mechanisms.
 



 Strong understanding of exception monitoring and operational support processes.
 



 Experience working with utility companies or utility implementations involving electric, gas, water, or energy services.
 



 Ability to investigate complex business process failures and determine functional root causes.
 



 Strong experience translating business requirements into SAP IS\-U functional solutions.
 



 Experience preparing functional specifications and working with technical development teams.
 



 Strong understanding of SAP IS\-U integration points and end\-to\-end business processes.
 



 Experience with SAP implementation, enhancement, production support, or transformation projects.
 



 Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



 Preferred Skills
 



 Experience with SAP S/4HANA Utilities and/or SAP IS\-U.
 



 Experience supporting large\-scale utility implementations or transformation programs.
 



 Knowledge of SAP FI\-CA and integration with IS\-U.
 



 Knowledge of SAP EDM, AMI, Device Management, and Meter Data Management processes.
 



 Experience with high\-volume utility billing and exception management environments.
 



 Familiarity with SAP IS\-U master data and technical objects.
 



 Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
 



 Experience coordinating with offshore/onshore functional and technical teams.
 



 Strong experience in production support and incident management.
 



 BPEM Functional Expertise
 



  
 



 The ideal consultant should be able to demonstrate practical knowledge of:
 



  
 



 BPEM architecture and business process exception concepts.
 



 Exception identification and monitoring.
 



 BPEM case creation and processing.
 



 Exception categorization and classification.
 



 Case prioritization and assignment.
 



 Processor determination and exception routing.
 



 Exception lifecycle management.
 



 Worklists and exception processing.
 



 Root\-cause analysis of recurring exceptions.
 



 Exception escalation and resolution processes.
 



 BPEM integration with SAP IS\-U business processes.
 



 Configuration and optimization of exception management processes.
 



 Reporting and analysis of exception volumes and trends.
 



 Designing business rules to improve automated exception handling.
 



 Reducing manual intervention through improved exception processing.

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
**Job Title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant** 




**Location: New York** 




  





**Position Overview**




 We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Functional Consultant with strong hands\-on experience across SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), Subscription Order Management (SOM), and FI\-CA.
 



 The ideal candidate will have experience working with usage/event data generated by upstream SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) and will be responsible for understanding and ingesting that data, defining the required downstream processing, and supporting the creation and processing of BITs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work as a functional SME across the SAP BRIM landscape, with a focus on CI, SOM, and FICA.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into functional BRIM solutions.
* Analyze event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM). Understand the structure, content, and business meaning of CM output data and determine how it should be processed within BRIM.
* Define the required mappings and transformations from incoming usage/event data into BITs. Ensure the appropriate BITs are created from the incoming usage/event data and are available for downstream processing.
* Work with technical teams to ingest and validate data received from CM.
* Support the end\-to\-end flow from CM output → data ingestion → BIT creation → Billing/Invoicing → FI\-CA.
* Support FI\-CA processes including account determination, postings, invoicing, payments, and receivables.
* Troubleshoot functional issues by tracing data across the BRIM landscape and identifying where processing or data discrepancies occur.
* Work closely with developers and integration teams on data mappings, interfaces, transformations, and BRIM integrations.
* Create functional specifications, mapping documents, and business process documentation.
* Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production issue resolution.
* Perform end\-to\-end reconciliation to ensure that incoming usage data results in the expected charging, billing, and financial postings.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional issues and validate expected outcomes.



  





**Required Experience:**



* 10\+ years SAP BRIM functional experience/Multiple Hands\-on BRIM Projects
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP CI, SOM, and FI\-CA.
* Experience working with event data received from SAP Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Experience writing functional specifications and working with technical teams to implement integrations and data transformations.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience working with subscription products would be preferred.

* Billing and invoicing operations

* Lead the design and architecture of SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) frameworks to process usage, events, and transactional data.

* Establish monitoring dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and reconciliation frameworks to ensure financial compliance and data integrity.
* Collaborate closely with finance, product, engineering, and external vendors to provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise.

* Extensive experience delivering end\-to\-end SAP BRIM implementations with a specific focus on Convergent Mediation (CM).
* Hands\-on proficiency configuring mediation flows, transformations, and integrations with SAP CC, CI, FICA, or external APIs.
* Deep understanding of event\-based architectures and processing large transactional data volumes.
* Ability to operate effectively at both a high\-level structural architecture phase and a hands\-on individual contributor level.
* Effective communication skills with a proven track record of collaborating across cross\-functional technical and business teams.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Experience in mobility, ride\-hailing, telecom, or subscription\-based business models.
* Familiarity with real\-time streaming technologies (such as Kafka), modern data pipelines, or cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong understanding of revenue assurance and financial reconciliation processes.


 $198,000 \- $237,000 a year

 Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. jobs.title: Billing Analyst
jobs.description:
The Billing Analyst plays a critical role in executing and maintaining accurate, compliant, and timely billing operations across all customer segments. Reporting to the Billing Supervisor within the Billing Operations organization, this role supports Brightspeed’s end\-to\-end billing process within the SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) platform. The position ensures data accuracy, revenue assurance, and operational efficiency through cross\-functional collaboration with Finance, IT, Revenue Assurance, and Customer Care teams.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Billing Execution and Analysis**
* Execute monthly billing cycles across multiple business segments using SAP BRIM.
* Review and validate rating, charging, and invoicing data to ensure accurate application of pricing, taxes, discounts, and contractual terms.
* Perform detailed pre\- and post\-billing reconciliations to ensure invoice integrity and completeness.
* Identify, document, and resolve discrepancies in source data, usage feeds, or customer hierarchies.


**Data Validation and Quality Assurance**
* Conduct audits of billing data to ensure compliance with company policies, SOX controls, and tariff or contractual obligations.
* Partner with IT, Finance, and Product teams to ensure BRIM master data (subscriptions, charges, price plans) are accurate and up to date.
* Support revenue assurance activities, reconciling billed versus unbilled usage and validating invoice\-level revenue alignment.


**System Support and Continuous Improvement**
* Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Operational Readiness Testing (ORT) during system releases, migrations, or new product implementations.
* Identify and recommend process improvements or automation opportunities to enhance billing efficiency and accuracy.


**Reporting and Collaboration**
* Develop and maintain billing dashboards and KPI reports to track cycle completion, accuracy rates, and exceptions.
* Collaborate with Accounting, Collections, Customer Service, and Revenue Operations teams to support billing dispute resolution and ensure end\-to\-end transparency.
* Communicate recurring issues, root causes, and recommended process enhancements to leadership.


**Company Description**
 At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.
   

  

 Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management,
 **our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best\-in\-class customer experience.**
 Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.
   

  

 Check us out on the web!
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
****Education \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2–4 years of experience in billing operations, preferably in telecommunications, SaaS, or subscription\-based billing environments.
* Experience with SAP BRIM modules (Convergent Invoicing, FICA, SOM) preferred.
* Familiarity with telecom product hierarchies, usage\-based billing, and taxation (E911, USF, SLED, etc.) is a plus.


****Skills \& Competencies****
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation, and reconciliation).
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and explain complex data anomalies.
